name: languageSource
help: Where the banner's wording comes from. Built-in English sends nothing and lets the banner use its own words, so it picks up improvements with each version; if the page carries window.ConsentioLanguage, the tag reads that instead. From a variable takes a whole language pack - the JSON text of a released en.json or el.json in a Constant, or any variable returning the same object. A published language pack loads one from the CDN, at the same version as the banner, so the words move with each release.
